conflicting_sizing.rule: Risking $500.00 with the stop at $98.00 ($2.00 per share at the latest close) sizes the position at 10 shares ($1,000.00), capped at what the stated account of $1,000.00 can buy.

setups.risk_note: Stop gaps, slippage and fees can exceed the calculated loss. Sizing does not check buying power.

breakout_reference.playbook: A daily close above the 20-bar high ($101.00) on volume above 1.5 × the 20-bar average volume (1,500,000 shares) is this setup's entry trigger, with the stop at $99.00. A close above the high on lighter volume is unconfirmed: wait for a confirming close. Do not chase above $101.00, where the first target ($105.00) is less than 2R away.

playbook.title: If it falls
playbook.text: A pullback to the 20-bar low ($99.00) is this setup's entry zone: buy only after a daily close holds above it, with the stop at $97.68. A daily close below $97.68 instead cancels the setup — do not buy; wait for a new 20-bar base to form. The next stored support below is the year low ($90.00).

playbook.title: If it rises
playbook.text: If the price rises without pulling back, this entry does not trigger — do not chase. Above $98.79, the first target ($101.00) is less than 2R away with this stop. A daily close above the 20-bar high ($101.00) on volume above 1.5 × the 20-bar average volume (1,500,000 shares) switches to the breakout setup instead.

playbook.title: If it goes sideways
playbook.text: While daily closes stay between the 20-bar low ($99.00) and the 20-bar high ($101.00) without a trigger, there is no trade. The 20-bar window rolls forward each day, so these levels are recalculated: refresh the plan after each close. Price alerts at the two edges tell you when either case starts.

playbook.title: After you are filled
playbook.text: Recalculate risk at your actual fill. Once a daily close is 1 ATR above the entry (above $101.64 from the $99.00 reference), move the stop up to the entry. At take profit 1 ($101.00) a common approach takes part of the position and trails the rest at the latest close − 2 × ATR toward take profit 2 ($102.96). A daily close below the stop exits.
